fields.meta_title: Requisition Form Builder for Any Request | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a requisition form for purchases, parts, new hires or lab tests. Each request is checked on submit and saved to a database you own.
fields.h1: Build a Requisition Form for Any Internal Request
fields.hero_description: Describe what your team asks for and who reads it. Emergent builds the requisition form, numbers every request and checks it on submit. Each one lands in a table you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Request Carries Before Anyone Reads It
fields.features_subheading: A paper requisition depends on the requester remembering every field. These six pieces fill the gaps while the form is still open.
fields.feature_1:
Requisition numbers on every submit

Assign the next number in your series, such as REQ-0419, when a request is sent. The requester quotes it in any follow-up, and purchasing finds the request without searching.
fields.feature_2:
Department and cost center from a list

Pick the department, and only its cost centers appear in the next dropdown. Nobody types a code from memory, and every request is charged where the budget owner expects it.
fields.feature_3:
Item lines with an estimated total

Add each item with its quantity and estimated unit cost, and the total updates as the requester types. Approvers see the full amount at the top instead of adding up lines by hand.
fields.feature_4:
A reason field that cannot be skipped

Ask why the item or role is needed and by what date, and make both required. The reader gets the business case with the request instead of emailing back to ask for it later.
fields.feature_5:
Attachments where policy needs them

Require a vendor quote, a job description or a spec sheet on the request types that call for one. Other request types never show the upload, and the form stays short for them.
fields.feature_6:
Your code, in your repository

Export the whole codebase to GitHub when IT wants the form on your own servers or wired into the ERP. The form and the requests table behind it belong to you, line for line.

fields.usecase_heading: The Requisitions Teams File Most Often
fields.tab_content_1:
A repeat order for monitors joins the request already open

Dana in operations at Northwind Logistics asks for 3 monitors for new hires. Before the request goes in, the form checks what her team already has open and finds REQ-0418, for 2 of the same model. She adds her 3 to it instead of filing her own. Purchasing reads REQ-0418 with 5 monitors on it.
fields.tab_content_2:
Every belt pulled for Extruder 3 lands on its asset

A drive belt on Extruder 3 snapped mid-shift at Globex Plastics. The maintenance tech picks the machine from a list, requests 6 drive belts from the parts crib and collects them at the window. The crib marks them issued, and the $110.40 is charged to asset EX-03 instead of a general supplies account.
fields.tab_content_3:
Any salary above the band waits for a written reason

Acme Robotics loses a QA engineer, and the team's manager opens a backfill requisition at level 3 with a salary of $128,000. The level 3 band tops out at $120,000. Before HR sees the request, the form asks him for a reason. He cites a competing offer, attaches the job description and sends it.
fields.tab_content_4:
No lab test leaves 4 West without its diagnosis code

On 4 West at Cedar Valley Hospital, a nurse orders a CBC and a basic metabolic panel for a patient admitted overnight. The form will not send until each test carries a diagnosis code and a collection time. The core lab receives requisition L-20417 with both, and the tube labels print with the same number.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Requisition Form
fields.howto_description: Start with the request that causes the most back-and-forth today, then add the others once it works.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Collect the paper or PDF version
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pull the requisition your team uses now, paper or PDF, along with the last 10 requests filed on it. Mark the fields people skip most often. Those become required fields, and everything else can stay optional.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down who reads each type of request, such as purchasing for items and HR for new roles. One form can carry several request types, each with its own reader and its own required fields.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Export your departments and their cost centers from the accounting system as one spreadsheet. Requesters pick from that list instead of typing a code, which keeps every request charged to a code that exists.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Pick a prefix and a starting number, such as REQ-0001, that will not collide with the PO numbers purchasing already uses. A distinct prefix tells anyone reading an email whether it means the request or the order.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the request types, required fields and the attachment each type needs into one prompt, and attach the spreadsheet. Emergent builds the form and a requests table behind it. Ask for changes in plain English as people use it.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Decide where each type goes next
fields.howto_step_6_des: Choose what happens on submit for each type. Item requests might post to purchasing in Slack while new roles go to a tracker HR already reads. Keep the requester copied on every update to their request.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run five old requests through it
fields.howto_step_7_des: Re-enter five requests from last month, including one that went wrong at the time. Check that the number and cost center land in the table as expected and that the problem request is caught this time.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is a definition blog (Nutrient), carbonless pads on Amazon, a fillable GSA Form 49, a nonprofit procurement manual, pdfFiller and Jotform templates, a dictionary entry and a university job requisition PDF. Google's AI Overview splits the term into purchase, internal stock and lab requisitions, and the related searches add hospitals and hiring. This page defines the term in one answer, then shows the four requisitions a searcher actually means: a purchase requisition that catches a duplicate request, a parts crib request charged to the machine, a job requisition checked against the pay band, and a hospital lab requisition that will not send without a diagnosis code. Approval routing and the PO itself stay on the purchase order siblings, linked from the FAQ.

claims_to_source: A requisition form is an internal request for goods, services or other resources made before any purchase or commitment
A purchase requisition is an internal request to buy that comes before the purchase order sent to the vendor
GSA Form 49 is the basic procurement request form the US General Services Administration uses when requisitioning equipment, supplies or services
A stores or materials requisition asks the warehouse or storeroom to issue items the organization already holds
A job requisition is an internal request for permission to fill a position, approved before recruiting starts
A lab requisition records the ordering provider, patient details, the tests ordered and a diagnosis code for each test
Some employers require the job description to be attached to every job requisition
